info.title: KromicStore API
info.description: Multi-tenant e-commerce API — manage products, orders, customers, payments, and webhooks.

get.summary: Gets all platform configuration sections.
Gets a specific platform configuration value.
Gets the configuration audit log with filtering options.
Exports configuration audit log as CSV file.

post.summary: Creates a new API key for the tenant.

get.summary: Gets all API keys for the current tenant.
Gets a specific API key by ID.

post.summary: Registers a new tenant and creates a TenantAdmin user.

requestBody.description: Registration request containing user and tenant information.

400.description: Validation error (invalid email format, weak password, missing required fields).

post.summary: Authenticates a user with email and password.

requestBody.description: Login request containing email and password.

post.summary: Refreshes an access token using a refresh token.
Authenticates a user via OAuth provider (Google).

requestBody.description: OAuth login request with provider and authorization token.

400.description: Invalid OAuth request (missing provider or token).

post.summary: Logs out the current user by invalidating their tokens.

get.summary: Gets all categories for the current tenant in hierarchical tree structure.

post.summary: Creates a new category.

400.description: Invalid category data (e.g., exceeds nesting limit, invalid parent).

403.description: User is not authorized to create categories.

get.summary: Gets details for a specific category including its subcategories and product count.

400.description: Invalid category data (e.g., circular reference, exceeds nesting limit).

403.description: User is not authorized to update categories.

delete.summary: Deletes a category and unassigns all associated products to null (root category).

403.description: User is not authorized to delete categories.

post.summary: Updates the display order of a category for UI sorting.

requestBody.description: The reorder request with new display order.

403.description: User is not authorized to reorder categories.

get.summary: Gets all tenant-specific configurations.
Gets a specific tenant configuration value.
Gets the configuration audit log for the tenant.

post.summary: Resets a configuration to its default (platform-wide) value.

get.summary: Exports configuration audit log as CSV file.
Gets a paginated list of customers for the current tenant.

post.summary: Creates a new customer.

400.description: Invalid customer data or email already exists.

get.summary: Gets details for a specific customer.
Gets the order history for a specific customer with pagination.

post.summary: Adds or updates a customer address (billing or shipping).
Verifies domain ownership via DNS TXT record.
Checks DNS configuration for a domain.
Initiates SSL certificate provisioning for a domain.

get.summary: Checks SSL certificate status for a domain.
Gets all feature flags for the current tenant.

post.summary: Creates a new feature flag.

get.summary: Checks if a specific feature is enabled.
Gets a specific feature flag by ID.
Liveness check - basic health status (always returns 200 if app is running).

head.summary: Liveness check - basic health status (always returns 200 if app is running).

get.summary:
Readiness check - verifies all dependencies (database, Redis, etc.) are accessible.
This also keeps Redis active by pinging it on each check.

head.summary:
Readiness check - verifies all dependencies (database, Redis, etc.) are accessible.
This also keeps Redis active by pinging it on each check.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of orders for the current tenant.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional filter by order status (pending, confirmed, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled).

post.summary: Creates a new order with inventory validation and reservation.

400.description: Invalid order data or insufficient stock.

get.summary: Gets details for a specific order including items and payment status.

put.summary: Updates an existing order (address and items if still pending).

400.description: Invalid order data or order not in pending status.

post.summary: Confirms a pending order.
Marks an order as shipped.

requestBody.description: The ship request with tracking number.

post.summary: Marks an order as delivered.
Cancels an order and releases inventory.

Initiates a payment for an order via Razorpay.
Returns Razorpay order details for frontend integration.

requestBody.description: Payment creation request with order ID and optional idempotency key.

400.description: Invalid request or order validation failed.

get.summary:
Verifies the current status of a payment.
Used to check if payment has been completed by the customer.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The payment ID to verify status for.

post.summary:
Requests a refund for a completed payment.
Can process full or partial refunds.

requestBody.description: Refund request with reason and optional amount.

400.description: Invalid refund request or cannot refund payment.

post.summary:
Saves payment gateway credentials for the current tenant.
Encrypts and securely stores Razorpay API keys and webhook secret.

requestBody.description: The payment configuration request containing Razorpay credentials.

400.description: Invalid request or missing required fields.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

409.description: Configuration already exists for this tenant.

500.description: An error occurred while saving configuration.

get.summary:
Retrieves the payment configuration for the current tenant.
Secrets are masked in the response for security.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

404.description: Payment configuration not found for this tenant.

500.description: An error occurred while retrieving configuration.

delete.summary:
Deletes the payment configuration for the current tenant.
This action disables payment processing until new configuration is provided.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

404.description: Payment configuration not found for this tenant.

500.description: An error occurred while deleting configuration.

post.summary:
Validates payment gateway credentials by attempting to connect to Razorpay API.
This endpoint helps ensure configuration is correct before enabling payment processing.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

404.description: Payment configuration not found for this tenant.

get.summary:
Checks if payment configuration exists and is active for the current tenant.
This endpoint is useful for frontend to determine if payment processing is available.

403.description: User does not have TenantAdmin role.

500.description: An error occurred while checking status.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of products for the current tenant.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional filter by product status (draft, published, archived).

post.summary: Creates a new product.

400.description: Invalid product data or duplicate SKU.

403.description: User is not authorized to create products.

get.summary: Gets details for a specific product.

403.description: User is not authorized to update products.

delete.summary: Soft deletes a product (marks as archived).

403.description: User is not authorized to delete products.

post.summary: Publishes a product (makes it available for purchase).

403.description: User is not authorized to publish products.

post.summary: Unpublishes a product (makes it unavailable for purchase).

403.description: User is not authorized to unpublish products.

get.summary: Get available subscription plans.
Get SuperUser configuration (contact details, etc).
Check if a subdomain is available for registration.

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: The subdomain to check availability for.

post.summary: Submit contact us form - sends email to superuser.

requestBody.description: Contact form data including name, email, and message.

500.description: Server error processing form or sending email.

post.summary:
Receives and processes Razorpay subscription webhook events.
Events include: subscription.charged, subscription.payment_failed, subscription.cancelled.

Receives and processes Razorpay payment webhook events for one-time payments.
Events include: payment.authorized, payment.failed, refund.created.

get.summary:
Gets the complete bootstrap data for the storefront.
This endpoint is used by the frontend to initialize the storefront with all required data.
Supports ETag for conditional requests and caching.

304.description: Not modified - client has cached version (ETag match).

404.description: Tenant not found or not resolved.

500.description: Server error during bootstrap data retrieval.

get.summary: Exports store data to JSON format.

post.summary: Creates a backup snapshot of the store.
Restores a store from a backup.
Creates a new storefront from an existing theme template.

requestBody.description: The request containing theme ID and storefront name.

422.description: Invalid theme ID or operation failed.

post.summary: Creates a new storefront from scratch without a theme template.

get.summary: Retrieves a storefront by ID (tenant-scoped).

403.description: User does not have access to this storefront (different tenant).
User does not have access to this storefront.
User does not have access to this storefront.

get.summary: Lists all storefronts for the tenant with pagination.
Validates mandatory fields for storefront publication.

403.description: User does not have access to this storefront.

post.summary:
Publishes a storefront (makes it publicly accessible).
Validates that all mandatory fields are provided before publishing.

403.description: User does not have access to this storefront.

422.description: Cannot publish: missing mandatory fields or invalid state.

put.summary:
Toggles the visibility of a component within a storefront.
Note: This is a placeholder endpoint. Full component management would require StorefrontComponents repository.

403.description: User does not have access to this storefront.

put.summary: Hides a component within a storefront.

403.description: User does not have access to this storefront.

put.summary: Shows a component within a storefront.

403.description: User does not have access to this storefront.

get.summary: Gets the current subscription details for the tenant.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

get.summary: Gets a list of all available subscription plans with feature comparison.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

post.summary:
Upgrades the subscription to a higher plan.
If a pro-rata charge is required, a payment is triggered automatically.

requestBody.description: The upgrade plan request containing the new plan ID.

400.description: Invalid plan ID or cannot upgrade to same/lower tier.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

404.description: Subscription or target plan not found.

409.description: Subscription is already pending cancellation or in an invalid state.

post.summary:
Downgrades the subscription to a lower plan.
A credit is applied to the next billing cycle for the price difference.

requestBody.description: The downgrade plan request containing the new plan ID.

400.description: Invalid plan ID or cannot downgrade to same/higher tier.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

404.description: Subscription or target plan not found.

409.description: Subscription is already pending cancellation or in an invalid state.

post.summary:
Requests subscription cancellation with a 30-day grace period.
After the grace period, the subscription will be fully deactivated.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

409.description: Subscription is already pending cancellation or in an invalid state.

post.summary:
Reactivates a cancelled subscription during the 30-day grace period.
After the grace period expires, the subscription cannot be reactivated.

403.description: User is not authorized (must be TenantAdmin or SuperUser).

404.description: Subscription not found or is not pending cancellation.

409.description: Grace period has expired; subscription cannot be reactivated.

get.summary: Gets platform-wide analytics dashboard data.
Gets tenant health metrics.
Gets system performance metrics.
Gets security alerts and incidents.

post.summary: Register a new SuperUser (platform admin).

requestBody.description: Registration request containing email and password.

400.description: Validation failed or email already registered.

post.summary: Login as SuperUser (platform admin).

requestBody.description: Login request containing email and password.

post.summary: Refresh SuperUser authentication token.
Logout SuperUser by invalidating their tokens.

401.description: Invalid authentication token or SuperUser not found.

post.summary: Suspends a tenant, making it inaccessible without deleting data.
Archives a tenant for long-term retention.
Soft deletes a tenant while preserving records for restore/retention.

requestBody.description: The soft delete request with reason.

post.summary: Restores a suspended, archived, or soft-deleted tenant.
Creates and sends a team invitation.

409.description: Invitation already exists for this email.

get.summary: Gets all invitations for the current tenant.
Gets a specific invitation by ID.
Lists all active themes available for storefront creation.

200.description: Themes retrieved successfully (may be empty list).

get.summary: Retrieves a specific theme by ID.
Retrieves a theme by slug identifier.
Gets current usage summary for the tenant.
Gets usage history for a specific type within a date range.

parameters.name: usageType
parameters.description: The usage type (Storage, ApiCalls, Bandwidth, Users).

get.summary: Checks if a specific quota has been exceeded.

post.summary: Registers a new webhook configuration.

requestBody.description: The webhook configuration request with endpoint URL and event types.

get.summary: Lists all webhooks for the current tenant with pagination.
Gets a specific webhook configuration.

400.description: Invalid webhook ID or request data.

post.summary: Sends a test event to the webhook endpoint.
Replays a webhook event.

get.summary: Gets delivery logs for a specific webhook.

400.description: Invalid webhook ID or pagination parameters.

tags.name: AdminConfig
tags.description:
API controller for platform-wide configuration management endpoints.
Accessible only to SuperUser role.

tags.name: ApiKey
tags.description: Controller for API key management.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description:
Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, token refresh, and OAuth authentication.
These endpoints are publicly accessible without authorization.

tags.name: Category
tags.description: Controller for managing product categories.

tags.name: Config
tags.description:
API controller for tenant-specific configuration management endpoints.
Accessible to TenantAdmin role.

tags.name: Customer
tags.description: Controller for managing customers.

tags.name: DomainManagement
tags.description: Tenant domain management and ownership verification endpoints.

tags.name: DomainVerification
tags.description: Controller for domain verification and SSL management.

tags.name: FeatureFlag
tags.description: Controller for feature flag management.

tags.name: Health
tags.description:
Health check endpoint controller.
Provides liveness and readiness checks with Redis keep-alive.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: SaaS operations settings: feature flags, maintenance mode, quotas, usage, and retention policy.

tags.name: Order
tags.description: Controller for managing orders.

tags.name: PaymentConfiguration
tags.description:
Controller for managing tenant payment configurations.
Provides endpoints to configure, retrieve, validate, and delete payment gateway credentials.

tags.name: Payment
tags.description:
Controller for managing payments and payment verification.
Handles payment creation, status verification, and refund requests.

tags.name: Product
tags.description: Controller for managing products.

tags.name: Public
tags.description: Public endpoints accessible without authentication.

tags.name: RazorpayWebhookReceiver
tags.description:
Webhook receiver controller for Razorpay payment and subscription events.
These endpoints are public and do not require authentication.

tags.name: Store
tags.description: Controller for storefront-related endpoints.

tags.name: StoreExport
tags.description: Controller for store export, backup, and cloning operations.

tags.name: StorefrontComponent
tags.description: Controller for managing storefront components (TenantAdmin+ authorization required).

tags.name: Storefront
tags.description: Controller for managing storefronts (TenantAdmin+ authorization required).

tags.name: Subscription
tags.description: Controller for managing subscription plans and lifecycle.

tags.name: SuperUserAnalytics
tags.description: Controller for SuperUser analytics dashboard.

tags.name: SuperUserAuth
tags.description: Controller for SuperUser authentication (platform admins).

tags.name: SuperUserPlatform
tags.description: SuperUser platform operations for tenant lifecycle, analytics, global search, and operational visibility.

tags.name: SuperUserTenant
tags.description: Controller for SuperUser to manage tenant lifecycle (suspend, archive, restore, soft delete).

tags.name: TeamInvitation
tags.description: Controller for team invitation and role management.

tags.name: Theme
tags.description:
Controller for retrieving themes (public - no tenant authorization required).
Themes are platform-wide resources available to all tenants.

tags.name: UsageReporting
tags.description: Controller for usage reporting and quota management.

tags.name: Webhook
tags.description:
API controller for webhook management endpoints.
Accessible only to TenantAdmin role.
